name: Rudra S.
headline: Pipeline 3x kiya in 60 days
blurb: Pipeline ₹40L/mo unpredictable thi—qualification framework + pre-sell sequence se ₹1.2Cr predictable pipeline built. Conversion bhi 12% → 31%.

name: Ayush K.
headline: Closing rate 45% improve
blurb: Webinar-to-enrollment 4% thi. Pre-sell nurture + objection handling upfront se 18% conversion achieve kiya. Cohort revenue ₹4L → ₹18L.

name: Priya M.
headline: Avg deal size 2.1x
blurb: Deal size ₹8L stuck thi. Value-based positioning + anchor pricing se avg deal ₹17L ho gaya. Win rate bhi 19% → 38%.

name: Karan D.
headline: Retainer revenue 4x
blurb: Transactional projects se ₹6L/mo stuck. Retainer model design kiya—MRR ₹24L in 5 months. Client LTV 8mo → 18mo avg.

name: Neha P.
headline: Churn 65% reduce
blurb: Client churn 4-5 months mein ho jata tha. Retention playbook + upsell ladder se avg retention 14 months. Revenue stability 3.2x.

name: Sameer R.
headline: Avg project ₹8L → ₹22L
blurb: Generic proposals aur price war mein stuck. Value-based scoping + case study positioning se avg project 2.75x. Proposal-to-close 14% → 41%.

name: Meera I.
headline: ₹25K → ₹1.8L packages
blurb: Hourly billing se income capped thi ₹40K/mo. Productized service + waitlist positioning se ₹1.8L packages sell kar rahi consistently.

name: Rohan T.
headline: Retainer model scale kiya
blurb: Solo consultant se ₹12L/mo retainer business built. Team hire kiya, leverage create kiya. Calendar se time bhi free hua 40%.
